_schema: genres.<name>.targets.<metric> = {min, max, unit, source, basis}; null = open end. basis: sourced | sourced-disputed | sourced-other-genre | example (one source, one value) | rule (work/b9/MUSICAL_RULES_B9.md) | measured-gate. A metric not listed is not checked: 'rules --genre' prints it as UNSURE. Ranges measured on the owner-approved multis are added by the atlas (fill from the atlas after the first build). Sources are cited as file:section; the research files carry the URLs.

dub-techno.qualitative: minor triad or m7, short loose syncopated stabs, tape-style echo, sparse and slowly changing

tempo_bpm.source: work/b9/research/dub-techno.md:Rhythm (Wikipedia, source 5); the Attack example runs 145, sources disagree

repeat_highcut_hz.source: work/b9/research/dub-techno.md:Effects (source 3: high cut ~5 kHz in the loop)

reverb_decay_s.source: work/b9/research/dub-techno.md:Effects (source 4 hall ~5 s; source 2 'short'; sources disagree)

side_mid_db.source: work/b9/MUSICAL_RULES_B9.md rule 4 (side -8 to -11 dB or wider)

deep-house.qualitative: m7/m9/m11 voicings, offbeat stabs, next chord on the last 16th, Juno chorus pads

delay_time.source: work/b9/research/deep-house.md:Effects (S5 dotted 1/8; S2 1/8 on electric piano)

classic-house.qualitative: minor chords, 4/4 quantised, simple bass line; no tempo, swing or reverb figure found (UNSURE)

wet_pct.source: work/b9/research/classic-house.md:Effects (S4, a deep-house source; no Chicago-specific figure)

detroit.qualitative: minor-key stabs and synth strings over a 4/4 kick; the sources give no numeric target (UNSURE)

acid.qualitative: 303 saw, 24 dB low-pass, accents and slides, overdrive; a bare square lead is allowed here (rule 6)

reverb_lowcut_hz.source: work/b9/research/acid.md: source 1 (reverb rolled off up to ~400 Hz)

electro.qualitative: 808 drums, mono bass, arps and bell tones, heavy reverb / delay / chorus (source 1); no numbers (UNSURE)

idm.qualitative: detuned unison, tape wobble, dark roomy reverb, melody and mood first

echo_lowpass_hz.source: work/b9/research/idm.md: source 3 (tape echo band-limited ~5 kHz; emulate with a 2-5 kHz low-pass)

berlin-school.qualitative: driving sequencer bass line, Mellotron choir, heavy reverb into delays; no tempo or effect numbers (UNSURE)

sequence_cycle_bars.source: work/b9/research/berlin-school.md: source 1 (linked sequencers of 4 and 8 bars)

ambient.qualitative: no pulse, sustained pad / vocal bed, long echo and reverb; one sourced semitone clash (source 1)

drone.qualitative: held bed, sparse by design; no online research file yet (UNSURE: a rule 3 exception needs a quoted source)
